description:
Primary action derived from the brand ramp (brand-ramp.resolver.json).

The base set MUST be declared on the same scope that remaps the ramp (:root and every
[data-a63-brand]): a var() inside a custom property resolves on the element where the
property is DECLARED, then inherits as a resolved value. Declaring only on :root would
freeze primary to the base ramp regardless of a downstream [data-a63-brand] override.
The brand contexts hold the few per-brand exceptions and follow the base set, so they
win at equal specificity.

$root.$description:
Step 600, not 500: white text on every brand's 500 falls below WCAG AA's
4.5:1 for normal text (the default blue is about 3.5:1); 600 reaches it.

foreground.$description:
Auto-contrast foreground: near-white on dark primaries, near-black on bright
ones (light brand picks / wallpaper golds). oklch `l` is the proxy; the steep
clamp is a light/dark STEP at l≈0.57, about where near-white and near-black
give the same contrast (WCAG Y≈0.18), so each fill gets whichever reads
better. The old step at 0.665 matched large-text 3:1 and left mid-lightness
custom brands on white text at 2.8–4:1. Chroma ×0.06 keeps a faint brand
tint. Supersedes JS --color-auto-foreground for components.

text-shadow.$description:
Subtle depth shadow under text on the primary (theme lever; Aqua sets a gel
tint). Default none so flat themes stay crisp.

text.$description: The brand as text on light surfaces (semantics.css --a63-text-accent).

$root.$description:
Green (b3) is lighter than the other ramps: white on its 600 is about 4.2:1,
so its primary action steps one shade further to reach AA.

text.$description:
Orange (b2) keeps 600 for fills (white text is about 4.7:1), but its 600 as
text on the lightly tinted Aqua page is just under 4.5:1.
